title: Schedule of Benefits — Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans
content:
Each of the six Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans includes the services below for one plan term. Counts are per term; a count of 0 means the service is not an included service of that plan.

## Part A — Counted services per term

| Included service | Puppy | Kitten | Adult Dog | Adult Cat | Senior Dog | Senior Cat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wellness exam | 4 | 4 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Fecal test | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Heartworm test | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| Blood panel | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Urinalysis | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Radiograph series | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| Dental cleaning | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| Nail trim | 4 | 4 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

## Part B — Core vaccines given at no charge as due during the term

| Plan | Core vaccines included |
|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | rabies, DHPP series, leptospirosis, bordetella |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | rabies, FVRCP series, FeLV series |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | rabies, DHPP, leptospirosis, bordetella |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | rabies, FVRCP, FeLV |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | rabies, DHPP, leptospirosis, bordetella |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | rabies, FVRCP, FeLV |

## Part C — Other included benefits and exclusions

| Benefit | Puppy | Kitten | Adult Dog | Adult Cat | Senior Dog | Senior Cat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sick-pet office visit fees, without limit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Telehealth (video and chat consultations) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| One microchip implant | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Age-appropriate deworming | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Anesthesia for an included dental cleaning | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Emergency, after-hours or specialist care | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered |
| Unused included services carry into the next term | No | No | No | No | No | No |

## Part D — Spacing between included wellness exams

| Plan | Minimum calendar days between two included wellness exams |
|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 21 |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | 21 |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 120 |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 120 |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 120 |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 120 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Dental cleaning is an included service only under the Senior Dog and Senior Cat Wellness Plans, and those are also the only two plans whose benefits include anesthesia for an included dental cleaning.
2. The microchip benefit is one implant, and it appears only in the Puppy and Kitten Wellness Plans.
3. No plan carries an unused count forward: a Senior Dog plan whose term ends with its one radiograph series unused begins the next term with the count of the new term only (hypothetical illustration).
4. Emergency, after-hours and specialist care sit outside every plan in this schedule.
